summary: Practise gender analysis, indicators, and action planning with recognised frameworks. Review the five-day course outline and see if it fits your role.
lede: Gender mainstreaming brings gender analysis into policy and programme decisions, from design through review. For programme officers, policy analysts and project planners, this training develops practical ways to map gender roles and resource access, interpret sex-disaggregated evidence, identify barriers and needs, and use the Harvard and Moser frameworks to shape responsive objectives, indicators, budget links and an accountable action plan.
audienceIntro: The course is designed for professionals who shape, fund, deliver, or monitor policies and programmes and need to account for different gender roles, needs, and outcomes.
modules: Gender Analysis Matrix: Barriers and Effects
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with programme, policy, or project planning is useful. Prior experience applying gender-analysis frameworks is not required for this foundation-level course.
